failures.assertion: `onClose` takes `(event, reason)` and branches on `reason` (`'backdropClick'` or `'escapeKeyDown'`) instead of a separate `onBackdropClick` handler
failures.evidence: `handleClose` takes `(_event: object, _reason: 'backdropClick' | 'escapeKeyDown')` but never reads `_reason`, and it branches only on `if (deleting) return;`.
